chunks.title: Generic External API .env.example Template
chunks.content:
Generic External API .env.example Template

Safe .env.example for backend services integrating with external APIs. Empty placeholders for API_BASE_URL (base URL of the external service) and API_KEY (authentication token). Generic template applicable to any third-party REST API.

Decision rules:
- Use API_BASE_URL to allow URL switching between sandbox and production endpoints
- Prefer bearer token (API_KEY) over username/password credentials for API authentication

Anti-patterns:
- Never hardcode API keys in source code or Dockerfiles
- Do not reuse a single API key across multiple services — provision separate keys per service
